lines.en: Foul bones crack, three heads advance.

lines.zh: 发出嘎吱声，伏地骨行走。

lines.en: Foul bones crawl through decayed soil.

lines.zh: 骨指抠进腐土拖动身躯。
lines.en: Bone fingers claw the rot and drag its body.

lines.zh: 三个头轮流低吼着挪动。
lines.en: The three heads take turns growling as it shifts.

lines.zh: 三颗头颅各自望着一边。
lines.en: Each of the three heads stares a different way.
Black powder seeps from its bone seams.

lines.zh: 伏地骨伏在骨堆里不动。
lines.en: The lurker lies still inside the bone heap.

lines.zh: 颈骨缓缓转动，无人发声。
lines.en: Its neck bones turn slowly, silent.
Three heads gaze at the player.
Lurker locks on to the player.
Three heads focus on the player.
Foul bones lock on to the player.
Three heads fix on the player.
Foul bones gaze at the player.

lines.zh: 三张脸同时抬起来看你。
lines.en: Three faces lift to look at you at once.

lines.zh: 你被六只眼窝一起锁定。
lines.en: Six empty sockets lock onto you together.

lines.zh: 它的头骨一齐转向你的方向。
lines.en: All its skulls turn toward where you stand.

lines.zh: 伏地骨从土里抬起半截身子。
lines.en: It lifts half its body out of the dirt.

lines.zh: 骨球在喉咙里滚动，瞄准你。
lines.en: A bone orb rolls in its throat, aimed at you.

lines.zh: 一个头看你，另两个在嗅你。
lines.en: One head watches you, the other two sniff.

lines.zh: 它认出你身上的活人气息。
lines.en: It recognizes the living scent on you.

lines.zh: 三颗头低声商议你的死法。
lines.en: The three heads whisper how you should die.

lines.zh: 腐骨的眼窝里亮起幽绿。
lines.en: A sick green light kindles in its sockets.

lines.zh: 它停下挖掘，直直望住你。
lines.en: It stops digging and stares straight at you.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，三颗头就跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you walk, all three heads follow.

lines.zh: 骨指在土上敲出你的方向。
lines.en: Bone fingers tap out the direction you took.

lines.zh: 腐骨开始剥落，慢慢破碎。
三头骨体散发出阴冷气息。
三头骨体变得越来越暗。
三头骨体逐渐变得模糊。
三头的骨体在诱惑你前行。
腐骨堆中传来诡异的低语。
lines.en: A whispering rises from the decayed bones.

lines.zh: 三颗眼睛紧盯着你，逼近。
lines.en: Three eyes lock onto you, closing in.

lines.zh: 腐骨的低语：靠近些，更多骨球。
lines.en: Decay whispers: Come closer, more bones.

lines.zh: 它们的触手般骨尾在等待。
腐骨的呼吸声令你毛骨悚然。
lines.en: Their breath sends shivers down your spine.

lines.zh: 三颗头同时转动，窥视着你。
腐骨在黑暗中发出微光。
lines.en: Foul bones emit a faint light in the dark.

lines.zh: 三颗头互相低语，似乎在商量。
lines.en: Three heads murmur to each other, plotting.

lines.zh: 腐骨的阴影似乎在拉你进去。
三颗头同时攻击，无法躲避。
lines.en: Three heads attack at once, nowhere to run.

lines.zh: 腐骨的骨球击中你，你眼前一黑。
lines.en: A bone ball strikes, blinding you.

lines.zh: 三头以惊人的速度向你逼近。
lines.en: Three heads close in at a startling speed.

lines.zh: 腐骨的触手迅速缠绕你。
lines.en: Their tentacles wrap around you quickly.

lines.zh: 三颗头合力向你发起冲击。

lines.en: Three heads collide with you at once.

lines.zh: 腐骨的撞击几乎将你击倒。
lines.en: Their impact nearly knocks you down.

lines.zh: 三头注视着对方，似乎在沟通。
lines.en: Three heads look at each other, communicating.

lines.zh: 腐骨的交配声令人毛骨悚然。
lines.en: Their mating sounds send shivers down your spine.

lines.zh: 三颗头互相触碰，似乎在互动。
lines.en: Three heads touch, seeming to interact.

lines.zh: 腐骨间传来轻柔的摩擦声。
lines.en: Soft scraping sounds between the bones.

lines.zh: 三头间似乎有着某种默契。
lines.en: There’s an unspoken understanding between them.

lines.zh: 腐骨彼此之间发出低沉的共鸣。
lines.en: They emit low resonances between them.

lines.zh: 三颗头互相靠近，似乎在接近。
lines.en: Three heads draw closer, seemingly approaching.

lines.zh: 腐骨在交配时显得格外安静。
三头似乎在进行某种仪式。
lines.en: They seem to be performing a ritual.

lines.zh: 腐骨间的互动令你不安。

lines.en: It fixes you in its sight!
Its voice reverberates in your ears!

lines.zh: 三颗头，三颗骨球，都对准你。
lines.en: Three heads, three bone orbs, all aimed at you.
Three-headed bone horror ready to act!
Three heads fix on you at once.

lines.zh: 它决定先杀你这个活的。
lines.en: It decides the living one dies first.

lines.zh: 骨球开始对准你的胸口。
lines.en: A bone orb lines up with your chest.
The lurker digs its way toward you.

lines.zh: 它把你记成了下一个猎物。
lines.en: It marks you as the next prey.

lines.zh: 三只头同时转向你的脖子。
lines.en: All three heads turn toward your neck.

lines.zh: 它注视着你的每一个动作！
lines.en: It watches every one of your moves!
A bone ball gathers in my throat.
It waits for the perfect moment!
It counts the gaps between your breaths.
The bone orb gathers into one in its throat.

lines.zh: 三个头分别盯着你的手脚。
lines.en: Each head watches a limb of yours.

lines.zh: 它等你背过身的那一刻。
lines.en: It waits for the moment you turn away.
Its bone fingers stop; it is charging up.

lines.zh: 凋零的气息顺着地面爬来。
lines.en: The smell of wither creeps along the ground.

lines.zh: 它计算着距离，一步不差。
lines.en: It measures the distance to the step.
The three heads go horribly quiet.
It means to take your sight first.

lines.zh: 骨球上的裂纹亮了一下。
lines.en: The cracks on the bone orb flare once.

lines.zh: 骨球砸开，黑雾糊住眼睛！
lines.en: The orb bursts and black fog blinds you!

lines.zh: 三个头一起咬住你的腿！
lines.en: All three heads bite your leg at once!
Wither slips in through the wound!
It bursts up from the ground under you!
Bone fingers press you into the rot!

lines.zh: 你眼前一黑，什么也看不见！
lines.en: Your sight goes black and nothing remains!

lines.zh: 骨荒原的裂缝里爬出三颗头。
lines.en: Three heads crawl from a crack in the bone waste.

lines.zh: 血肉平原上，腐骨开始聚合。
lines.en: On the flesh plains, rotten bone gathers.

lines.zh: 基岩之下的洞口透出骨声。
lines.en: Bone clicks come up from the hole below bedrock.

lines.zh: 它从失落文明的坟里站起。
lines.en: It rises from the grave of a lost civilization.

lines.zh: 三颗颅骨在黑暗里排成一列。
lines.en: Three skulls line up in the dark.

lines.zh: 腐土翻动，伏地骨钻了出来。
lines.en: The rot churns and the lurker pushes out.
Three faces suddenly grow from the bone pile.

lines.zh: 地底的骨头都朝这里聚集。
lines.en: Bones from below all gather here.

lines.zh: 它带着凋零的气味落地。
lines.en: It lands carrying the smell of wither.

lines.zh: 黑暗深处传来三声低吼。
lines.en: Three low growls sound from the dark.

lines.zh: 伏地骨在骨原上睁开了眼。
lines.en: The lurker opens its eyes on the bone field.
Hit by bone ball, bones crack.

lines.zh: 魔法力量侵蚀，腐骨崩解。
进入虚无空间，腐骨消失。
